notes.title: Wishlist Milestone & Prize Pool Update
notes.content: [p]Kinky Cats has been added to the Steam wishlist by [b]10,000[/b] people! [b]Thank you for your incredible support![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Next milestone is 15,000[/b] and we're ready to pump up the rewards![/p][p][/p][p]We will distribute all prizes among players who log into Kinky Cats during the first few days of release. [b]Add[/b] [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3339200?utm_source=steam&utm_campaign=fest&utm_content=milestone"]Kinky Cats[/url] [b]to your wishlist[/b] on Steam and unlock even more rewards in the early days of launch![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529793/32460bc5fbb652b1872d84a76874470d96019c20.png"][/img][/p]
